evidence.title: shadscan: Audit shadcn apps for UI fundamentals
GitHub - TheOrcDev/shadscan: Deterministic UI audits for shadcn apps, built for your terminal, your CI, and your AI agent.

name: shadscan
summary: CLI and GitHub Action that statically audit React shadcn apps against 62 UI rules and score them from 0 to 100.
description: A deterministic, read-only CLI for React shadcn apps: run it from a project root (npx @shadscan/cli, no install) and it scores UI fundamentals from 0 to 100 with cited evidence across 62 rules in six categories — foundation, interaction, states, accessibility, forms and production polish. Reports separate fixes, decisions and advisories; output comes as human text, JSON or a paste-ready agent handoff, with score gates, a composite GitHub Action, a pre-commit hook and an MCP server. A web scanner and hosted API cover public GitHub repositories.
contains: 62 deterministic rules across six weighted categories
scores UI fundamentals 0-100 with evidence behind each finding
categories: foundation, interaction, states, accessibility, forms, production polish
human, JSON and agent-prompt output; fail-under score gates
composite GitHub Action and pre-commit score gate
MCP server with scan, listprojects and explainrule tools
web scanner and hosted API for public GitHub repositories
